notes.title: Gaming Copilot Upgrade: A Smarter, More Flexible Game Assistant
notes.content:
Hello everyone, the latest Gaming Copilot upgrade is here! This update focuses on the actual needs you've shared, adding support for multiple screens and audio devices, expanding voice tone choices, and enriching the game strategy library—just to make you more powerful, more free, and happier in the virtual world!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45144715/ed12ec66e5e698f6738b29231ec3b28eec8e51f8.png[/img]

[h2][Multiscreen Combat – Take Full Command][/h2]
[i]“No more tabbing out for guides!”[/i]
The new version supports content capture across multiple screens. Freely select any screen or game window for screenshot analysis and real-time translation. Whether it's live translation during combat on your main screen, or fast map breakdowns on your secondary display—Gaming Copilot finds what you need instantly.

[h2][Audio Device Flexibility – Talk Your Way][/h2]
[i]“Friends too noisy? Just switch mics!”[/i]
With multi-microphone support, easily switch to the clearest input in noisy or multiplayer environments. Whether you're whispering late at night or shouting in a stream—Gaming Copilot accurately picks up every command.

[h2][More Voice Styles – Your Companion Gets a Voice Makeover][/h2]
[i]“Feeling like a gentle older sister or a funny uncle today?”[/i]
We’ve added more voice styles for popular languages (like English and Chinese), covering tones like humorous, calm, or passionate. Let a cyberpunk uncle design your strategy or have a tsundere gamer girl walk you through the plot—it’s all your call! More voice styles coming soon to keep your AI buddy fresh and exciting.

[h2][Bigger Strategy Library – Old and New Games Covered][/h2]
[i]“Adapting to players across the web—continuously”[/i]
1,000+ classic game guides added. Strategy matching is now improved even for games not on the list. Whether it’s secret achievement routes, boss mechanics, or stat optimization—Gaming Copilot helps you overcome every challenge!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45144715/83876759db3f67f22f34d38204ab7a5d3149a11c.jpg[/img]

[h1]A Quick Look Back at Classic Features – Always Here for You[/h1]
🗺️ Precise Guides: Lost in maps? Stuck on quests? Tap into our deep strategy pool for instant optimal paths
🎙️ Voice Interaction: Ask by voice with zero delay—combo tips, story choices—talk and conquer
🖼️ Screenshot Analysis: Smart visual parsing—item stats, puzzles, traps—AI sees it all
🎮 Real-Time Translation: One-tap source recognition and live translation—no more language barriers
🤖 Always-On Buddy: Cheer you on when you win, lift you up when you lose—your cyber pal, 365 days a year

[h2]You Are Never Alone in the World of Games[/h2]
Gaming Copilot keeps evolving, so every player finds their own style of companionship. Whether you're a hardcore competitor, a story lover, or a lonely star craving connection—there’s always an AI partner who understands you.

Update Now and Start a New Adventure!
Your next epic achievement starts with Gaming Copilot.

notes.title: Gaming Copilot v1.2.0 Update: Real-time Translation Break Language Barriers
notes.content:
Dear Players,

Thank you for your continued support and companionship! To make your gaming experience more seamless and immersive, Gaming Copilot has released the brand-new v1.2.0 update. This update brings several practical optimizations to make every adventure even more enjoyable!

[h2]1. New Translation Feature: Unlock Global Gaming Without Language Barriers[/h2]
Now, you can summon Gaming Copilot to translate in-game text in real-time while playing! Whether it’s quest dialogues, item descriptions, or hidden lore, simply press a hotkey to translate text into 12 common languages (such as English, Japanese, and Korean). The translation interface supports adjustable transparency and font size, and you can switch between translation and chat modes with a single click.

Many players abandon their favorite games due to language barriers, and this feature aims to break that limitation. While the current translation accuracy is still being optimized (testing phase), it already helps you quickly understand game content without missing key details. We will continue improving it in future updates to make cross-server co-op even easier!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45144715/f88098466425956781431f6a688ec79223977288.png[/img]

[h2]2. Character Art Customization: A More Flexible Companion Experience[/h2]
You can now freely adjust the transparency and position of your companion character! Depending on the game scene, you can set character transparency independently (to avoid screen obstruction) or drag the character anywhere on the screen.

Whether you need full focus during intense battles or prefer a quiet companion while exploring, this feature ensures that your AI buddy is "just right"—never intrusive, yet always by your side for added immersion.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45144715/092fbaef1ec3e0020e3b4426b8b131f44a604ff0.png[/img]

[h2]3. Smarter AI Conversations: More Human-like, Better at Solving Problems[/h2]
Gaming Copilot’s conversation logic and response speed have been greatly improved! Now, it can not only chat more naturally but also integrate search results directly into its answers (e.g., how to obtain rare items or unlock special achievements), allowing for quick solutions even to niche problems. The "Deep Thinking Mode" remains available for those who want to explore complex strategies.

Whether you’re a beginner asking, "How can I level up fast?" or a veteran wondering, "What’s the best way to defeat the hidden boss?" the optimized AI provides more precise and human-like assistance, truly becoming your "gaming encyclopedia."

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45144715/d63af1569f5badcf966f18c74819e27d45db9639.png[/img]

[h2]4. Expanded Guide Library & Stability Enhancements[/h2]
This update includes expert guides for several popular games (with more to come), covering story analysis, map routes, gear combinations, and other useful content.

Additionally, we’ve fixed multiple bugs reported in previous versions, improved system stability, and enhanced response speed to ensure a smoother interaction with Gaming Copilot!

We firmly believe that the magic of gaming lies in exploration and connection. Gaming Copilot is here to make every adventure more free, warm, and full of possibilities. If you have any suggestions or feedback on the new features, feel free to let us know—your voice drives our progress!

See you in the game, fellow adventurers!

notes.title: Gaming Copilot v1.1.1 is here: Your gaming experience is upgraded!
notes.content:
Dear gamers, hello everyone! 

We are very pleased to announce that the Gaming Copilot v1.1.1 version has officially been released. Gaming Copilot has always been committed to being the most considerate and helpful AI gaming partner for you, and this update brings a lot of sincerity to add more fun and convenience to your gaming journey.

[h2]1. A more powerful "smart brain" to solve your doubts precisely[/h2]
We have optimized the model configuration of Gaming Copilot, and now it is connected to the new general models of GPT and DeepSeek. We have also optimized the configuration for some unstable interfaces, enabling it to automatically choose stable and fast interfaces. At the same time, we have optimized the deep thinking function. Now, when deep thinking is activated, it will default to conducting online searches (prioritizing access to some game forums and communities) to collect more information for supplementation. We hope to provide you with more in-depth and detailed answers, so that you will no longer be troubled by any doubts in the game.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45144715/076d1f89e9048772ad9a2396570d104fd1dea4d7.png[/img]

[h2]2. Richer strategy data covering more games[/h2]
We have updated a large number of game strategies, including item collection, achievement acquisition methods, general strategy guides, opening gameplay, plot summaries, and other common questions. This will help you take the lead in various tasks and get accurate answers in a timely manner. We have also made separate adaptations for more classic and popular games. Now, in the drop-down list in the upper right corner of the chat box, you can search and select more specific games. We will continue to update and configure, making Gaming Copilot your "encyclopedia" in the gaming world.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45144715/0cdc0dc0374d6e21bb8fa444521bf83a0d381853.png[/img]

[h2]3. Personalized character illustrations to create your exclusive gaming partner[/h2]
Many players hope that their gaming assistant can have a unique image. Therefore, we have initially added a character configuration function. In addition to the default two mechanical half-human character illustrations, you can customize the character illustration image, which will be stored locally and will not be uploaded to the cloud. You can feel free to use your creativity to create a one-of-a-kind gaming partner image. Whether it's your favorite anime character or a unique image you designed yourself, it can make your gaming assistant more personalized and give you a strong sense of exclusivity in the game.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45144715/0d6bacd38f8d3d39382b8fc59a77888ea912e3c2.png[/img]

[h2]4. Optimized interface configuration for a smoother experience[/h2]
Based on your feedback, we have made many optimizations and adjustments to the interface configuration:
[list]
[*] Adjusted and combined chat configuration tabs
[*] Separated sound volume and sound effect volume configurations, supporting separate mute
[*] Whether it's text or voice questions, the voice generation reply is unified, and you can configure automatic playback or manual playback of the voice
[*] Fixed other issues
[/list]

Thank you very much for your support and love. We will continue to update and optimize to bring you a better gaming experience. We hope that Gaming Copilot can start your exclusive gaming companionship journey and become the most indispensable good partner in your gaming world.

notes.title: How to Play the Fall Sale Games? Let Gaming Copilot Help You!
notes.content:
Dear friends, have you bought a lot of games during the big sale and are now struggling to figure out how to play them? Don’t worry, Gaming Copilot is here to assist! Recently, our Demo received its final major update before the official release. This isn’t just a typical update—it's a chance to elevate your gaming experience! From "pretty good" to "wow, this is awesome," our AI gaming buddy is now fully equipped to guide you through every corner of the gaming world.

[h2]Fast AI Response[/h2]
In this version, the AI’s response speed has been significantly improved. For example, in Grand Theft Auto V, have you ever gotten lost in the streets of Los Santos and needed to find the nearest weapon shop? Or, while on the run, urgently needed a safe house? With the latest upgrade to Gaming Copilot, these answers come back instantly. It’s like hitting the boost button—our AI has turbocharged its responses, making your adventures in Los Santos smoother and faster than ever.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45144715/3c944a6a7be7dcb95c04f19d40d3379e26daa02b.png[/img]

[h2]Deep Thinking Mode[/h2]
In Stardew Valley, you might face questions like: How can I balance crop planting with animal husbandry to maximize profits? Or which crops are best to plant in each season? Gaming Copilot’s Deep Thinking Mode acts like your personal farm advisor, providing carefully thought-out strategies to help you run your farm more efficiently. Tip: You can enable Deep Thinking Mode from the lower right corner. Although it may slightly increase response time, it significantly enhances the accuracy of the answers.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45144715/b0b065aa5a39a4e7063d189c86570fe95e503e9e.png[/img]

[h2]Game-Specific Optimizations[/h2]
Beyond general game Q&A features, we’ve also added special optimizations for some popular games, which you can select or input from the top right corner. For example, when playing Baldur’s Gate 3, if you need to devise a complex battle strategy or need help with character skill trees, just ask, and Gaming Copilot will provide deep, game-specific recommendations. It’s like having your own personal game mentor, helping you conquer the challenges of the Dungeons & Dragons universe.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45144715/421bd7262382aae206c501b6ba6df0b1c022f17a.png[/img]

[h2]Personalized Convenience Settings[/h2]
Finally, we’ve added more personalized and convenient settings to Gaming Copilot: You can quickly show or hide the window using shortcuts, like a HUD that’s always ready at your command; adjust the font size to make the text clear and readable; or tweak the volume to perfectly balance game background sound with Gaming Copilot's responses. These settings allow you to tailor your gaming experience to your needs, making your gaming journey more personalized and comfortable.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45144715/ebbd925df5a24a02f3830220db6e5ee3d7a0df90.png[/img]

Gaming Copilot, your cyber gaming buddy, is ready to take you into a whole new world of gaming. Don’t hesitate—download the updated Demo now and let’s become an unbeatable legend in the gaming world together!

notes.title: Gaming Copilot Update: Demo Release and Community Events!
notes.content:
[h1]🚀 Gaming Copilot Demo is Now Live! 🎮🤖[/h1]
Hey, gamers! We're super excited to announce that the[u][b] Gaming Copilot Demo[/b][/u] is ready and can help you conquer the gaming world! 🕹️ Let our AI game assistant become your trusted ally. Here are a few things you need to know:

[h2]Fullscreen mode mischief![/h2]
💡Some games might experience display issues in fullscreen mode, such as [u]flickering[/u], [u]disappearing windows[/u], or [u]accidentally switching back to the desktop[/u]. Don't worry! Try switching to [b]windowed[/b] or[b] borderless mode[/b], and your gaming experience will be back on track.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45144715/371afa2d82b3234c75f761b1014a719fe5354298.png[/img]

[h2]AI might make some mistakes...but it's [b]getting smarter[/b]![/h2]
💡 Our team is constantly optimizing game strategies and the AI model. If the AI gives you an answer that seems a bit ""off,"" just tell it: ""Try again!"" It'll rethink and give you a more reliable response. After all, AI learns too!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45144715/35de3569e05653c69f8b2d3a632eea1a495288b9.png[/img]

[h2]Your feedback helps us improve![/h2] 
💡We are constantly improving based on your feedback! We haven’t been able to test all games yet, If you encounter any issues, feel free to reach out to us through [b]Discord[/b], [b]Twitter[/b], [b]YouTube[/b], or even [b]Email[/b], and we’ll address them as soon as possible. Your feedback is what drives our evolution!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45144715/ded962e9f611a27c156883eb1c806bb4ff6f90e8.png[/img]

[h2]Community Update![/h2]
[list]
[*]🌟[b]Quiz Challenges: Regular quiz events to test your gaming knowledge, climb the leaderboard, and win big prizes![/b]
[/list]
[list]
[*]🌟[b]Giveaway: Participate in community interactions and stand a chance to enter lucky draws for game items and gift cards![/b]
[/list]
[list]
[*]🌟[b]Invite Rewards: Invite friends to the community, and once your invites reach certain milestones, you'll earn exclusive rewards. The bigger the community, the bigger the rewards![/b]
[/list]
[list]
[*]🌟[b]Creative Memes Contest: Share your funniest and most creative game memes, win votes from the community, and earn rewards and titles![/b]
[/list]
We've already given away over [b]$300[/b] in gift cards and game rewards, and more community events are underway. Come join us and enjoy the fun!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45144715/5de9bf289ec1c89d9381b8a20c3e0a5566441b14.png[/img]

[h3]Development Progress[/h3]
[list]
[*][b]Added Window Pinning:[/b] Keep the window on top, no more losing it behind other apps!
[/list]
[list]
[*][b]Support for Full Window Hiding:[/b] Don’t want the window to distract you? Now you can completely hide it!
[/list]
[list]
[*][b]Added AI Reply Sound Notification:[/b] AI has replied! You’ll get a sound notification, so you won’t miss it even when gaming!
[/list]
[list]
[*][b]Added Stop AI Reply Feature:[/b] In a hurry? You can now interrupt the AI’s response and ask again!
[/list]
[list]
[*][b]Fixed Repeated Running Reminders:[/b] Annoying repeated reminders are gone, everything is cleaner!
[/list]
[list]
[*][b]Added Support for Strategy Games:[/b] Strategy game fans, rejoice! We’ve added more support just for you!
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45144715/ad795b30802cdd664ca4187e3c30e85d462829f1.png[/img]

[h3]Your game, your choice![/h3]
Got a game you want AI to support? Let us know! 🎮 We'll [b]prioritize[/b] the games the community loves the most, making Gaming Copilot your trusted gaming companion.
